lines.1: English was first period today, so I had to get my head in the game.
lines.3: 「First, I shall return your midterm exams.」
lines.4: 「Ibuki. A fair result. Please set your sights still higher.」
lines.5: 「Fukahire. You seem remarkably relaxed. At this rate, you will have the pleasure of repeating your second year.」
lines.6: 「Date. You are capable of better than this. I expect more from you.」
lines.7: 「Tsushima. It is a shame you missed such easy points. Do be diligent about reviewing every day.」
lines.8: Gah... That was a painfully mediocre score. Sixty-eight.
lines.10: 「Now for the girls. Uraga. You have a long way to go.」
lines.11: 「Crab. On the finals, I hope you will show me that even the tiniest worm has some spirit in it.」
lines.12: 「Kiriya. Nothing to criticize. Excellent as always.」
lines.13: 「Yoppi. Thank you for falling so neatly into my trick question. Your score itself was excellent.」
lines.14: 「Please don't call me Yoppi too, Miss Inori...」
lines.15: 「Miss Inori's comments change pretty blatantly depending on the student...」
lines.16: Her words were impeccably polite, but what she actually said could be pretty brutal.
